The nodes that hold a value the user changes (checkboxes, toggles, switches, selectors, sliders, text fields) and the scrollbars, each one a behavior class with a skin class of named parts.
Learn: [Controls](/use/learn/interactivity/controls/), [Text fields](/use/learn/interactivity/text-fields/), [Give your controls a look](/use/learn/going-further/ui-kit/).

[`BaseCheckboxNode`](/reference/controls/basecheckboxnode/), [`BaseChoiceNode`](/reference/controls/basechoicenode/), [`BaseScrollbarNode`](/reference/controls/basescrollbarnode/), [`BaseSelectorNode`](/reference/controls/baseselectornode/), [`BaseSliderNode`](/reference/controls/baseslidernode/), [`BaseToggleNode`](/reference/controls/basetogglenode/), [`CheckboxNode`](/reference/controls/checkboxnode/), [`DoubleSliderNode`](/reference/controls/doubleslidernode/), [`FieldNode`](/reference/controls/fieldnode/), [`IntegerSliderNode`](/reference/controls/integerslidernode/), [`LineFieldNode`](/reference/controls/linefieldnode/), [`ScrollbarNode`](/reference/controls/scrollbarnode/), [`SelectorNode`](/reference/controls/selectornode/), [`SliderNode`](/reference/controls/slidernode/), [`StringSliderNode`](/reference/controls/stringslidernode/), [`SwitchNode`](/reference/controls/switchnode/) and [`ToggleNode`](/reference/controls/togglenode/) need a skin, a subclass that draws the node: see [Give your controls a look](/use/learn/going-further/ui-kit/).

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`BaseCheckboxNode`](/reference/controls/basecheckboxnode/) | class | The behavior of a checkbox without its look: a `boolean` that a left press on the node toggles. |
| [`BaseChoiceNode`](/reference/controls/basechoicenode/) | class | The behavior shared by the controls that select one value among options: the switch, the selector and the sliders. |
| [`BaseScrollbarNode`](/reference/controls/basescrollbarnode/) | class | The behavior of a scrollbar without its look: it reads the scroll of the node it serves and scrolls it when the user drags along the bar. |
| [`BaseSelectorNode`](/reference/controls/baseselectornode/) | class | The behavior of a drop-down list without its look: a choice whose list opens on a left press and closes on the next one. |
| [`BaseSliderNode`](/reference/controls/baseslidernode/) | class | The behavior of a slider without its look: a choice whose options sit along the width of the node, picked by a press or a drag. |
| [`BaseToggleNode`](/reference/controls/basetogglenode/) | class | The behavior of a toggle without its look: a `boolean` that a left press switches, and the two values it stands for. |
| [`CheckboxNode`](/reference/controls/checkboxnode/) | class | A checkbox made of two parts: a `box` that covers the control and a `mark` shown while it is checked. |
| [`DoubleSliderNode`](/reference/controls/doubleslidernode/) | class | A slider over a range of decimal numbers with a fixed step. |
| [`FieldNode`](/reference/controls/fieldnode/) | class | The base of every text field: it edits a text, reads a value of type `V` from it, and handles the focus, the cursor, the selection and the clipboard. |
| [`IntegerFieldNode`](/reference/controls/integerfieldnode/) | class | A one-line field that holds an `Integer` between a minimum and a maximum, stepped by Up, Down and the wheel. |
| [`IntegerSliderNode`](/reference/controls/integerslidernode/) | class | A slider over a range of integers. |
| [`LineFieldNode`](/reference/controls/linefieldnode/) | class | A one-line field: Enter submits it, and its text scrolls sideways to follow the cursor. |
| [`MultilineTextFieldNode`](/reference/controls/multilinetextfieldnode/) | class | A field of several lines whose value is its text, wrapped in its width. |
| [`ScrollbarNode`](/reference/controls/scrollbarnode/) | class | A scrollbar made of two parts: a `track` that covers the bar and a `thumb` sized and placed from the scroll of the node it serves. |
| [`SelectorNode`](/reference/controls/selectornode/) | class | A drop-down list made of a `field` and one node per option, with the selected option on top and the others in rows under it or above it. |
| [`SliderNode`](/reference/controls/slidernode/) | class | A slider made of two parts: a `track` that covers the control and a `thumb` placed at the value. |
| [`StringSliderNode`](/reference/controls/stringslidernode/) | class | A slider over a list of texts, such as quality levels, given as texts or as the constants of an enum. |
| [`SwitchNode`](/reference/controls/switchnode/) | class | A choice that shows every option side by side, one node per option, and selects the option under a left press. |
| [`TextFieldNode`](/reference/controls/textfieldnode/) | class | A one-line field whose value is its text. |
| [`ToggleNode`](/reference/controls/togglenode/) | class | A toggle made of two parts: a `track` that covers the control and a `knob` that slides from the left (off) to the right (on). |

## Related types

The interfaces, enums and helper classes of this family that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`FieldSelection`](/reference/controls/fieldselection/) | class | A range of characters of a field, from a start index to an end index. |
| [`RangeList`](/reference/controls/rangelist/) | class | Read-only list of the options of a slider range, whose values are computed from their index instead of stored. |
| [`ToggleState`](/reference/controls/togglestate/) | class | The two values that a toggle stands for, one while it is on and one while it is off. |
